children: Hong Kong, November 18, 2026-- Moody's Ratings has upgraded Health and Happiness International Holdings Limited's corporate family rating and senior secured rating to Ba2 from Ba3. At the same time, we have revised the outlook on Health and Happiness International Holdings Limited to stable from positive.

title: Moody's Ratings upgrades Health and Happiness's ratings to Ba2; outlook stable
